name: phoenix-security
description: Phoenix Security skills for Claude Code: AppSec review, threat modelling, SAST rule generation, CTI research, security-first PRDs, readiness gates, and documentation automation.

plugins.name: phoenix-security-review
plugins.description: AppSec review suite: multi-language security-reviewer, whole-repo security-assessment, diff-scoped 0day-scanner, STRIDE/DREAD threat-modeling, and two threat-model-driven review tiers. 6 skills, 4 commands, 1 subagent, 3 opt-in hooks.

plugins.name: phoenix-readiness-reviews
plugins.description: Two adversarial gates: is the plan implementable, and is the code actually shippable. Counted READY / NOT READY and SHIP / NO-SHIP verdicts with a deterministic repo scanner.

plugins.name: phoenix-sast-rules
plugins.description: Generate opengrep/semgrep SAST rules for 30+ languages, with an optional CVE/CWE research pass first.

plugins.name: phoenix-cti-search
plugins.description: Threat intelligence search across 595 curated security domains in 4 authority tiers. Skill needs no API key; bundled Node CLI, MCP server and /cti-search command.

plugins.name: phoenix-prd-pipeline
plugins.description: Security-first specification pipeline: a one-shot PRD generator plus 12 stage-by-stage roles from context curation to a final ship gate.

plugins.name: phoenix-docs-research
plugins.description: Documentation and research: a 6-mode self-healing project documenter, a NotebookLM connector for citation-backed answers, and a web + YouTube research pipeline.
